correctness.rationale: For deck generators (x,y)→(x,y+b),(x,y)→(x+a,−y), the intrinsic squared distance from anchor P=(0,v) to Y=(x,y) equals min[x²+A_y,(a−x)²+B_y], with A_y=dist(y−v,bZ)² and B_y=dist(y+v,bZ)². Since |A_y−B_y|<=b²/4<=a², integration over x uniform in [0,a] of the positive part gives a²/12+(A_y+B_y)/2−(A_y−B_y)²/(4a²). Writing h={2v/b}, the circular squared-distance correlation is exactly h²(1−h)²/3; I independently integrated the two polynomial branches symbolically. Consequently m(v)=(a²+b²)/12−b⁴ h²(1−h)²/(12a²). Conditional independence of D(P,Y)²,D(P,Z)² given P makes shared-endpoint covariance Var(m(P)). The exact quartic beta moments 1/30 and 1/630 yield Var(h²(1−h)²)=1/2100, so covariance=b⁸/(302400a⁴). Pair overlap counting yields the stated finite-n U-statistic variance, and the nondegenerate bounded Hoeffding projection yields sqrt(n) CLT with variance b⁸/(75600a⁴). Boundary a=b/2 included; no claim for a<b/2 or ambient distances.
